job.title: Product Marketeer - B2B Marketing @ ENGIE - International Supply & Energy Management (Brussels, Brussels Region, Belgium)
job.description:
**Product Marketeer B2B – Supply and Energy mgmt. – B2B – BP Belgium**
**Are you passionate about turning complex solutions into clear and compelling customer propositions? Are you commercially minded and data-driven when designing impactful marketing campaigns? Do you have a passion for the energy transition and the appetite to turn customer insights into business opportunities?**
**Then this job is for you!**
At
**ENGIE Belgium**
, we help companies accelerate their energy transition every day through innovative energy, green and flexibility solutions. As the energy landscape evolves, Green and Flex services are becoming increasingly important drivers of value creation for our customers. The B2B Marketing team plays a key role in translating these opportunities into compelling customer propositions, impactful campaigns and market-leading customer experiences.
  
  
To strengthen our Marketing team, we are looking for a
**Product Marketeer B2B (M/F/X)**
who will translate our energy and energy transition solutions into impactful go-to-market actions.
  
  
In this role, you sit at the crossroads of
**Marketing, Sales, Product Management and Customer Intelligence**
. You transform customer insights, market trends and product priorities into targeted campaigns, qualified leads and strong commercial support for our Sales teams.
  
  
Working closely with internal and external partners, you contribute to the growth of ENGIE's B2B business by increasing customer engagement, supporting acquisition and retention, and helping customers advance on their energy transition journey.
  
  
**WE OFFER YOU as Product Marketeer B2B**
  
  

* Cutting edge trainings that are organized by ENGIE University. These will not only help you to develop your knowledge on our different businesses, but also will give you a chance to acquire new hard and/or soft skills
* A competitive salary package, with numerous extra-legal benefits:

+ A tax-optimized bonus plan
+ Hospitalization and medical expenses insurance for you and your family members
+ Meal vouchers of 10 EUR with net contribution of 1,09 EUR
+ An attractive retirement plan
+ Green (electric) Company car with load pass for Belgium and neighboring countries or a green alternative through our mobility plan
+ A public transport subscription; our offices are less than 10 minutes from Brussels North station

* A healthy work-life balance thanks to 34 holidays.
* A gym on-site and a variety of activities offered in the ENGIE’s Body-Mind & Social program which aims to enhance our employees’ well-being.

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES As Product Marketeer B2B**
**Product Marketing & Go-to-Market**

* Translate complex energy, sustainability and flexibility solutions into clear and compelling customer value propositions.
* Develop product marketing plans and execute go-to-market strategies aligned with the business strategy.
* Ensure consistent product positioning and messaging across digital channels, sales materials and customer communications.
* Develop sales enablement materials and tools to help Sales teams effectively position and sell our solutions.
* Work cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Business Product Owners, Communications, IT, Pricing and other stakeholders.
* Explore AI-enabled marketing capabilities to improve personalization, content creation, campaign effectiveness and Sales support.

**Campaign Management & Lead Generation**

* Design and execute targeted cross-channel campaigns supporting acquisition, retention, win-back, cross-selling and upselling.
* Create engaging marketing content such as product webpages, e-books, videos, blog articles, brochures, newsletters and case studies in close collaboration with Communications.
* Use CRM and customer data to improve targeting, segmentation, personalization and customer engagement.
* Develop inbound marketing approaches and leverage marketing automation throughout the customer journey.
* Collaborate closely with Sales Managers and Account Managers to generate high-quality leads and support opportunity development.

**Market Intelligence**

* Turn customer feedback into actionable insights for Product and Business teams.
* Conduct market, customer and competitor analyses to identify trends, opportunities and competitive differentiators.
* Stay ahead of market and technology developments relevant to B2B energy customers and the energy transition.

**Performance Management**

* Monitor campaign performance and conversion through web analytics, reporting and dashboards.
* Continuously optimize campaigns based on performance, ROI and commercial impact.
* Ensure structured follow-up of marketing-qualified leads in collaboration with Sales.
* Translate marketing performance into clear insights and recommendations for Marketing and Sales stakeholders.

**YOUR PROFILE as Product Marketeer B2B**

* You hold a Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field.
* You have at least 3 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably within energy, utilities, services, telecom or another B2B environment.
* You are fluent in French, Dutch and English.
* You combine strong marketing expertise with a commercial and customer-oriented mindset.
* You are comfortable working with CRM data, customer segmentation and campaign performance indicators.
* You have experience with digital marketing, marketing automation and/or customer engagement tools.
* You know how to translate complex products and services into simple and compelling customer benefits.
* You enjoy collaborating closely with Sales teams and understand the importance of lead quality and commercial follow-up.
* You are analytical, structured and result-oriented.
* You are curious about new technologies and interested in AI-supported marketing tools.
* You are flexible, eager to learn and continuously look for opportunities to improve.
* You are proficient in Microsoft Office 365, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* You are a true team player who enjoys working closely with the Marketing Manager and the wider Marketing team.
* You are based in Brussels and can work from home according to ENGIE's applicable hybrid-working policy.

**OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS**

* CV pre-selection based on the key requirements.
* In-depth HR interview with the Talent Acquisition Partner, online or on-site.
* 1-hour online assessment covering abstract reasoning skills, personality and motivation.
* Second on-site interview with the Hiring Manager / interview panel, consisting of the Hiring Manager and senior employee.

**Research shows that men apply when they meet 60% of the requirements while women only apply when they are convinced they meet 100%. Don't let that hold you back, we'd love to hear from you!**
**More About Us**
ENGIE Supply & Energy Management (S&EM) is the energy management business unit of ENGIE and plays a key role in delivering reliable, affordable and low-carbon energy solutions worldwide.
  
  
By joining S&EM, you become part of a global community of more than 10,000 energy professionals across 20 countries, working together to accelerate the energy transition and provide decarbonized energy 24/7.
  
  
At ENGIE, we believe innovation, diversity and inclusion are key drivers of performance and progress. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, contribute and grow.
  
  
Our positions are open to all, including candidates with disabilities, and we are dedicated to providing an inclusive and supportive recruitment process.

Binnen onze business unit
**Window & Façade Solutions**
zoeken we een
**Digital Marketeer**
die mee bouwt aan onze online zichtbaarheid en merkbeleving. In deze veelzijdige rol combineer je strategisch inzicht met een hands-on aanpak en krijg je de ruimte om écht impact te maken binnen een internationaal groeibedrijf.

Als Digital Marketeer neem je ownership over onze digitale marketingactiviteiten en help je onze merken verder groeien.

Je staat onder meer in voor:

* Het opzetten, beheren en optimaliseren van digitale campagnes via onder andere
  **Google Ads, Meta Ads en LinkedIn Ads**
  , zowel zelfstandig als in samenwerking met externe partners.
* Het creëren, plannen en publiceren van boeiende content voor onze socialmediakanalen, steeds in lijn met onze merkidentiteit.
* Het analyseren van campagne- en websiteprestaties en het vertalen van data naar concrete aanbevelingen en verbeteracties.
* Het ontwikkelen van sterke marketingassets in
  **Adobe Creative Cloud**
  en het aansturen van externe creatieve partners zoals fotografen en videografen.
* Het versterken van onze online vindbaarheid via
  **SEO**
  , waaronder zoekwoordenonderzoek, contentoptimalisatie en het identificeren van nieuwe opportuniteiten.
* Het opzetten en optimaliseren van
  **marketing automation flows**
  die bijdragen aan leadgeneratie en klantengagement.

**Wie ben jij?**

* Je hebt minstens
  **2 jaar ervaring**
  binnen digital marketing. Ervaring aan bureauzijde is een mooie plus.
* Je combineert een creatieve mindset met een analytische blik.
* Je hebt ervaring met tracking- en rapporteringstools zoals
  **Google Analytics**
  ,
  **Google Tag Manager**
  of gelijkaardige platformen.
* Je weet hoe je digitale advertentiecampagnes succesvol opzet, opvolgt en optimaliseert.
* Je hebt ervaring met
  **Adobe Creative Cloud**
  (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, ...).
* Je werkt gestructureerd, stelt vlot prioriteiten en respecteert deadlines.
* Je bent een sterke teamspeler die ook zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid neemt.
* Je communiceert vlot in het
  **Nederlands en Engels**
  . Een basiskennis Frans is vereist.

**Wat mag je verwachten?**

* Een uitdagende marketingfunctie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en zichtbare impact.
* Een competitief salarispakket aangevuld met aantrekkelijke extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering, nettovergoeding, fietslease en de mogelijkheid tot een salariswagen.
* Flexibiliteit met de mogelijkheid om
  **1 dag per week thuis te werken**
  .
* Een aantrekkelijk verlofpakket met
  **12 extra ADV-dagen**
  dankzij een 39-urenweek binnen een 37-urenstelsel.
* Een warme en collegiale werkomgeving waar
  **"Winning Together"**
  meer is dan een slogan.
* Tal van opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden om jouw professionele ontwikkeling verder te stimuleren.

**Klaar om jouw digitale marketingexpertise in te zetten binnen een innovatieve en internationale omgeving? Solliciteer vandaag en bouw samen met ons mee aan sterke merken en duurzame groei.**

job.title: Marketing Lead @ Sodexo (Brussels, BRU, BE)
job.description:
### **Functie**

De **Marketing Lead** maakt van Marketing in Sodexo België een **meetbare groeimotor**.

Als owner van het food-aanbod (merken, productconcepten, retail), de prijsarchitectuur van dat aanbod en van de klant- en consumentenervaring (CCX), stuur je de concepten en het team aan op intelligent en onderbouwd investeren & aantoonbaar rendement. Je neemt een tactisch-operationele rol in en leidt het marketing departement vanuit jouw expertise als marketeer.

De Marketing Lead vertaalt de globale strategische visie & richting van de Sodexo groep naar een lokaal marketingplan en dit in nauwe samenwerking met de afdelingen Food/Culinary, Supply en Sales.

Wat al deze afdeling drijft en verbindt, is onze liefde voor gezonde, kwalitatieve voeding, ondernemerschap, team & service spirit.

### **Profiel**

Rol & verantwoordelijkheden :

- Je bouwt een groeiplan per prioritair merk en segment met concrete omzet- en margedoelen, gekoppeld aan de pipeline in Salesforce.

* Je meet het rendement van elke marketinginvestering (campagnes, concepten,lanceringen, Pubmarket-opdrachten) en stuurt het budget bij op basis van resultaat.

* Je bent mede-eigenaar (met Finance) van de prijsarchitectuur van het consumentenaanbod: instapprijzen,

prijsladders per categorie en premiumniveaus, getoetst aan de lokale markt.

* Je rapporteert maandelijks aan de Customer Marketing Director over groei, marge en rendement.

* Je bepaalt de richting van het CCX-programma voor het food-aanbod (luisteren, begrijpen, handelen).

* Je leidt, coacht en geeft richting aan het team van experten.

Opleiding: master in marketing, handelswetenschappen of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.

Ervaring: minstens 10 jaar in brand-, retail- of commerciële marketing (foodservice,

retail, FMCG of horeca), waarvan minstens 5 jaar leidinggevend, met eigen

verantwoordelijkheid voor omzet- of margedoelen.

Talen: Nederlands en Frans vloeiend, Engels goed.

### **Aanbod**

**It all starts with the everyday!** Als marktleider in België van catering en facilitaire diensten dragen we met onze kernwaarden **team spirit, dienstverlening en vooruitgang** bij aan een duurzame toekomst, een positieve impact op het milieu en een veilige werkomgeving voor al onze medewerkers.

Wij bieden jou een boeiende functie in een dynamische organisatie waar verantwoord ondernemen, diversiteit en inclusie, opleidingskansen en doorgroeimogelijkheden centraal staan.

Werken bij Sodexo is niet zomaar een job. Het is een kans om bij te dragen aan iets groters, omdat we geloven dat onze dagelijkse acties een grote impact hebben. Bij ons kun je doelgericht werken en jezelf op je eigen manier ontplooien. Concreet houdt dit in :

* Een voltijds contract van onbepaalde duur
* Een aantrekkelijk loonpakket waar Quality of Life centraal staat :
  + Flexibele home office policy voor een goede work-life balance
  + Hospitalisatie- en tandzorgverzekering & groeps- en invaliditeitsverzekering
  + Eindejaarspremie (13e maand), maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, cadeaucheques voor jubilarissen en familiale gebeurtenissen
  + Bedrijfswagen met tank- of laadkaart
* Een gepersonaliseerd onboardingtraject voor een soepele start bij Sodexo & mogelijkheid tot talrijke opleidingen
* Extra verlof- en anciënniteitsdagen
* Hoofdzetel vlakbij het Centraal Station in Brussel en telewerk mogelijkheid

**Klaar om de volgende stap in je carrière te zetten?**
-------------------------------------------------------

Herken je jezelf in dit profiel? Aarzel dan niet om te solliciteren!  
Heb je toch nog enkele vragen vooraleer je solliciteert, neem gerust contact op met onze HR Business Partner Tineke Van den Bossche via tineke.vandenbossche@sodexo.com

### **Talen**

Nederlands, Frans en Engels zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

job.title: Marketing Lead Solid Tumors, Benelux @ BeOne Medicines (Antwerp, Flemish Region, Belgium)
job.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.
  
  
The Marketing Lead Solid Tumors, Benelux Solid Tumor is the strategic and operational leader of the solid tumor franchise in the Benelux, acting as the ‘CEO’ of the brands she/he manages and fully accountable for its growth, positioning, and lifecycle management in a highly competitive specialty care and hospital environment. Reporting directly to the Country Manager Benelux, this role owns the end-to-end brand strategy and its flawless execution, from insight generation and forecasting to omnichannel engagement, field force enablement, and cross-functional alignment.
  
  
The Marketing Lead plays a critical role in the achievement of the commercial goals and defined performance parameters. The role combines strong strategic thinking with hands-on leadership of tactics and execution, ensuring that global and regional strategies are translated into locally winning plans, fully adapted to complex access dynamics, tender environments, clinical pathways, and key stakeholder networks. The Marketing Lead plays a pivotal role in driving performance through deep market understanding, actionable insights, best-in-class promotional and omnichannel solutions, and indirect leadership of the field force, always in full compliance with regulatory, quality, and ethical standards.
  
  
**Essential Functions Of The Job**
Franchise strategy and positioning:
  
  

* Develop and own the Benelux franchise strategy in alignment with global and regional direction, with clear ambition, growth priorities, and competitive positioning
* Translate scientific value, clinical differentiation, and patient benefit into compelling, customer-centric value propositions across indications and lines of therapy
* Lead local lifecycle management, scenario planning, and preparation for pipeline expansion, acting with a long-term, sustainable growth mindset for the country cluster
* Lead the creation of the cross-functional brand plans and provide input on commercial tactics at a cluster and national level, in alignment with international/regional brand plans
* Build the country tactical plans in close cross-functional partnership, ensuring insights from the field teams are integrated appropriately

**Go-to-market And Omnichannel Execution**

* Design and implement integrated go-to-market and omnichannel engagement strategies tailored to specialist and hospital stakeholders across the Benelux cluster. This may require an adapted approach for each country
* Drive the development and implementation of the local brand strategy through the deployment of an omnichannel marketing plan adapted to the 3 countries
* Drive the coordination of the action plan taking into account advice from therapeutic area experts, and drive the operational deployment of the plan in alignment with the customer journey strategy
* Identify innovative opportunities to increase the differentiation of the brand, and boost its SOV
* Lead the development of high-impact, compliant promotional and non-promotional materials, including core messages, campaigns, digital assets, congress content, and customer journeys
* Ensure consistent, high-quality execution across channels, continuously optimizing based on performance data and customer feedback. Create and implement continuous post launch product updates through customer-oriented marketing in order to improve access to patients

**Field Force Enablement And Indirect Leadership**

* Act as strategic partner and indirect leader of the sales and account teams by providing clear direction, priorities, tools, and capabilities
* Support and coach the field teams in the development and implementation of impactful account plans. Where required, play an active part in the implementation
* Plan and run regular trainings and updates for KAMS, partnering with Medical Affairs and Learning & Development. Develop and deliver training, messaging, and launch readiness programs to ensure strong product knowledge, disease understanding, and confident value communication
* Drive alignment between strategy and execution through regular field engagement, business reviews, and performance dialogue

**Insights Generation,, Analytics And Business Planning**

* Lead systematic generation and analysis of market, customer, access, and competitive insights from multiple sources (field, CRM, secondary data, KOLs, market research)
* Translate insights into clear strategic choices, segmentation, targeting, and tactical priorities
* Regularly perform co-visits with KAMs, organize compliant engagements with therapeutic area experts to inform the strategy, projects and to coach on implementation
* Builds the forecasting models and updates accordingly as market insights evolve. Owns forecasting assumptions for the franchise, including scenario analysis, tender impact, and uptake curves, and actively contribute to S&OP and planning cycles
* Own and manage the marketing OPEX for Benelux, own project management (contracts, invoicing, communication) for commercial activities and projects together with the Benelux Marketing Coordinator). Provides monthly updates of the budget vs planning
* Ensures regular tracking and reporting of relevant KPIs and overall performance of key BeOne commercial franchise initiatives. Conduct deep-dives, and define corrective actions where needed. Tracks and reports competitive initiatives, and adapts plans if required

**Market Access And Stakeholder Strategy**

* Work closely with Market Access, Medical, and Sales to ensure aligned value narratives, evidence plans, and stakeholder engagement strategies.
* Support access planning, guideline inclusion, network development, and institutional positioning, particularly in complex hospital and tender-driven environments.
* Contribute to strategies for key accounts, centers of excellence, and national or regional decision-making bodies. Provide valuable input to the preparation of national and local tenders

**Cross-functional And Matrix Leadership**

* Act as a central integrator across Sales, Medical, Market Access, Finance, and Global/Regional Marketing
* Lead cross-functional brand teams with clear objectives, accountability, and delivery focus
* Manage budgets, agencies, and external partners with strong ROI mindset and execution excellence

**Compliance, Quality And Governance**

* Act as a role model for full compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, industry codes, and company policies
* Ensure that all promotional activities and materials meet medical, legal, and regulatory standards and that adverse events, product complaints, and safety information are reported accurately and in a timely manner
* Ensure high-quality documentation of customer interactions and activities in CRM, in line with data quality, audit, and inspection-readiness requirements
* Build a culture of integrity, patient focus, and ethical decision-making across all brand-related activities

**Education And Experience Required**

* Master Degree (i.e. business economics/management, pharmacology, biomedical sciences, etc.)
* Extensive experience (+7 years) in pharmaceutical marketing within specialty care and Benelux hospital settings, preferably in oncology or hematology
* Proven track record in leading brands or franchises in competitive, access-restricted environments
* Strong strategic capability combined with hands-on execution excellence and operational discipline
* Highly analytical, with the ability to transform complex data and insights into clear decisions and actions
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and to lead cross-functional and field teams in a matrix organization
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, credible with senior internal and external partners
* Entrepreneurial, performance-driven mindset with strong ownership, accountability, and resilience
* Deep commitment to compliance, quality, and patient-centricity

**Computer Skills**
Proficiency in all MS Office Programs (especially Excel and PPT), Outlook, WorkDay and CRM tools. Strong skills in regularly using the AI-tools provided by the company
  
  
**Other Qualifications**

* Fluent in Dutch, French and English (written and spoken)
* A very good understanding of the Benelux solid tumor treatment and hospital landscape
* Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills, including ability to synthesize data and deliver a clear overview of commercial strategy, opportunities, and risks
* Experienced and skilled in omnichannel management, in creating and implementing successful strategies and initiatives to increase both the SOV and impact of customer touchpoints
* Mindset of the candidate: agile, entrepreneurial, collaborative and solution oriented. Have the ability to navigate in a rapidly changing internal and external environment, leading both directly and indirectly in a cross-functional context (both within the country cluster and the region
* Ability to prioritize, to focus on what matters most
* Multiplier skills: skilled to establish and entrench a winning mindset in the team, with the right belief, focus and accountability
* Agility, good judgment, and decision making, external focus, problem solving, positive attitude and curiosity, driven by innovation and excellence, creative, professional with high integrity, attracted to diversity and international multi-cultural working environment

**Travel**
The Senior Product Manager Solid Tumor Benelux is based in Belgium, Luxembourg or the Netherlands, traveling regularly between the country to perform co-visits and see customers. Willingness to travel frequently abroad (congresses and internal meetings), mainly in Europe

Salary Range Netherlands: 92,800.00 EUR - 116,000.00 EUR
  
  
Global Competencies
  
  
When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity, and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.
  
  

* Fosters Teamwork
* Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
* Self-Awareness
* Acts Inclusively
* Demonstrates Initiative
* Entrepreneurial Mindset
* Continuous Learning
* Embraces Change
* Results-Oriented
* Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
* Financial Excellence
* Communicates with Clarity

job.title: Responsable Webmarketing / Communication Grand Public – Événementiel / Pop culture (H/F) @ Sefa Event (Noisy-le-Grand, A8, FR)
job.description:
**Qui sommes-nous ?**

SEFA EVENT est une société d’événementiel au cœur des communautés de la culture japonaise et de la pop culture. Elle organise Japan Expo Paris, le plus grand festival d’Europe consacré à la culture japonaise, qui vient de fêter avec succès ses 25 ans en accueillant 222 048 visiteurs au Parc des Expositions de Paris Nord Villepinte.

Japan Expo, c’est LE rendez-vous des amoureux du Japon : manga, anime, jeu vidéo, musique, arts martiaux, culture traditionnelle. Avec Amazing, son espace dédié à toutes les pop cultures, le festival fait aussi voyager ses visiteurs bien au-delà du Japon : K-pop, webtoon, K-beauty, comics, licences occidentales de films, séries et jeux.

Derrière cet événement hors norme, une équipe à taille humaine où chacun voit concrètement l’impact de son travail.

**Votre mission**

Rattaché(e) au Directeur Commercial et Marketing, vous êtes le/la chef(fe) d’orchestre de la communication grand public des festivals Japan Expo. Votre objectif est simple : vendre le plus de billets possible, tout en renforçant l’image des festivals auprès des fans. Vous pilotez tout le parcours, de la première annonce jusqu’à l’achat confirmé, puis à la fidélisation, avec une équipe de 3 personnes (assistant(e) communication, social media manager, rédacteur(rice) web), des agences et les autres services.

**Attirer**

* Vous construisez le plan de campagne de chaque festival autour des temps forts de vente : ouverture de billetterie, phases tarifaires, annonces d’invités, dernière ligne droite.

* Vous orchestrez les opérations d’influence avec des créateurs dont l’audience correspond à nos publics, avec des codes promo et des liens suivis pour mesurer les billets vendus.

* Vous pilotez l’agence de presse, les partenariats avec les médias grand public et les achats d’espace (affichage, cinéma…), et vous organisez la conférence de presse.

* Vous développez nos publics européens : contenus en anglais, campagnes géociblées, partenaires et créateurs locaux.

**Convertir**

* Vous êtes responsable de la performance du site des festivals comme outil de vente : programmation, billetterie, mobile, vitesse, référencement naturel (SEO).

* Vous auditez le tunnel d’achat, repérez où l’on perd des acheteurs, et menez avec la Billetterie une feuille de route d’optimisation de la conversion : landing pages, tests A/B, réduction des frictions.

* Vous développez les ventes complémentaires en ligne : signatures, concerts, produits dérivés, packs.

**Fidéliser et animer la communauté**

* Vous développez notre base de contacts avec consentement et concevez newsletters et scénarios automatisés : préventes réservées aux inscrits, relances, réachat pour l’édition suivante.

* Vous définissez la ligne éditoriale des réseaux sociaux Japan Expo / Amazing et supervisez l’émission Twitch avec votre équipe.

* Vous organisez la couverture en direct des festivals et veillez à l’e-réputation de la marque.

**Piloter et manager**

* Vous mettez en place un dispositif de mesure fiable (GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels, API de conversion, UTM, consentement conforme à la CNIL) et construisez un tableau de bord de pilotage par festival et par semaine.

* Après chaque festival, vous présentez à la Direction un bilan chiffré : ce qui a vendu ou non, à quel coût, et ce qu’on change l’année suivante.

* Vous managez votre équipe, construisez et suivez le budget du service, et évaluez agences et prestataires sur leurs résultats.

* Vous travaillez main dans la main avec la Programmation, la Billetterie, le Studio Graphique et l’Accueil Visiteurs.

**Pourquoi ce poste est fait pour vous**

* **Un poste à fort impact :** vous êtes évalué(e) sur les billets vendus, et vous voyez le résultat de votre travail dans les allées du festival.

* **Un terrain de jeu complet :** acquisition, CRO, SEO, e-mailing, réseaux sociaux, Twitch, presse, influence, data : peu de postes réunissent autant de leviers.

* **Un univers passionnant :** vous travaillez au contact des grands noms de la pop culture japonaise, coréenne et occidentale.

* **Une vraie autonomie :** vous prenez en charge votre périmètre, testez de nouveaux formats et d’outils (IA générative, automatisation), et vous généralisez ce qui marche.

Votre profil

**Indispensable**

* Bac +4 / Bac +5 en marketing digital, communication, e-commerce, ou formation équivalente.

* Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en webmarketing, acquisition ou communication digitale grand public, dont une expérience réussie de management.

* Des résultats démontrables en optimisation de la conversion (CRO), acquisition à la performance et analyse de tunnels e-commerce ou billetterie : vous savez expliquer précisément comment vous avez augmenté des ventes, chiffres avant/après à l’appui.

* La maîtrise des plateformes publicitaires (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Ads, YouTube) et des outils de mesure (GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM, Looker Studio ou équivalent), ainsi que du RGPD appliqué au marketing digital.

* Des bases solides en SEO, en CMS (notions de HTML/CSS) et en outils d’e-mailing et de marketing automation.

* L’aisance avec Excel / Google Sheets pour analyser des données de vente.

* Une excellente maîtrise du français et un anglais bilingue.

* Une connaissance approfondie et à jour de la pop culture japonaise et des univers de Japan Expo / Amazing : manga, anime, jeu vidéo, J-pop, K-pop, webtoon, cosplay, licences et communautés de fans.

* Le goût des chiffres et du résultat : vous raisonnez en billets vendus, en coûts et en taux de conversion.

* Du leadership : vous fédérez une petite équipe autour d’objectifs clairs et la faites progresser.

* De la rigueur et de la réactivité : vous vérifiez vos informations, votre tracking, vos budgets, et vous restez efficace et posé(e) pendant les pics de vente.

**Un vrai plus**

job.title: Brand lead @ H Company (Paris, Île-de-France, France)
job.description:
**About H:**
H Company is a next-generation AI research and product company pioneering the future of autonomous, agentic AI. Founded to build intelligence that acts, H Company is creating the foundational infrastructure for autonomous AI systems that drive real-world outcomes across industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
Today, H is known for its story: its founders, its funding rounds, its press. We want it to be known for its value. Your mission is to make H one of the top 3 brands that large-enterprise decision-makers think of in enterprise AI, in France first, then in the US.
  
  
You will be our first Head of Brand, and the owner of the Brand pillar of our marketing strategy, alongside Growth and Product Marketing. You'll take over a brand foundation that is being shaped right now (positioning, identity, messaging house) and turn it into a brand that holds for the next five years in a market that reinvents itself every quarter.
  
  
Our brand stance is that of a
**pragmatic visionary**
: bold on vision, precise and evidence-led on capability. You'll be the guardian of that balance, making sure every piece of work speaks the language of the boardroom and holds up to the scrutiny of a CTO/builder.
  
  
You'll work hand in hand with leadership, Product, Research, Sales, our FDE teams and Communications, and with our external brand and PR agencies.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Lead the brand relaunch (Foundations)
  
  

* Take ownership of the new brand platform: positioning, identity, tone of voice and messaging house, and drive its rollout internally and externally.
* Turn our convictions into a story that is ours: what we believe, why we exist, what makes our approach to enterprise problems unique.
* Build a brand system that flexes by market (France, UK, US) without losing coherence, and that separates our two registers: a bold "vision voice" and a precise "capability voice".
* Set and enforce brand guidelines across every touchpoint: website, decks, events, product, recruiting.

Shift the narrative (Reputation)
  
  

* Move the public conversation about H from founders and funding to product, value and customer outcomes.
* Make trust a brand signal: reliability, ownership, resilience and our research-first approach (we own our models, we are not a wrapper), carried through proof rather than claims.
* Co-own reputation with Communications: Brand defines the positioning, Communications amplifies it through PR and executive voice.

Build awareness where our buyers are (Awareness)
  
  

* Design the brand plan that puts H in front of large-account decision-makers: flagship events, recurring PR moments, ecosystem programmes, content and campaigns.
* Prepare and lead the brand side of our US launch.
* Partner with Growth so awareness turns into qualified relationships and pipeline.

Earn authority (Authority)
  
  

* Grow H's thought leadership around the execution gap in enterprise AI and "AI that actually works".
* Lead strategic sponsorships and labels (e.g. Institut Polytechnique de Paris, our Resilient AI label) and partnerships with academics and consulting firms.

Build the function
  
  

* Manage brand budget and agencies (brand studio, freelancers).
* Ensure brand integrity
* Track and show the awareness impact

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 5+ years in brand, marketing or communications, including for a B2B Saas tech company
* You have led a brand repositioning or relaunch end to end, from strategy to rollout, and can show what it changed.
* You have built awareness among enterprise decision-makers, and you have measured it (brand tracking, share of voice, consideration).
* You understand deep tech well enough to translate it for a board without dumbing it down, and to defend it in front of engineers.
* You are as comfortable with a CEO and a leadership team as with a brand studio or a PR agency, and you know how to brief, challenge and arbitrate.
* You think in systems and act in details: a clear strategy, a sharp eye for craft, and a bias for shipping.
* Fluent English is required; French is a strong plus.

You Might Be a Great Fit If...
  
  

* You have built a brand in an emerging category, where the words themselves were still being defined.
* You have worked across Europe and the US and know how a story needs to flex from one market to the other.
* You care about proof: case studies, customer voices and numbers matter more to you than slogans.
* You are low ego and high ownership, and you like building a team and a function from the ground up.

Location
  
  
Paris/London, hybrid: 3 days a week on average in our office (8 rue Sainte-Cécile, 75009) or with customers. Regular travel to London and the US.
  
  
What we offer
  
  

* Join the early days of one of Europe's most ambitious AI companies, and shape how the world sees it.
* Real ownership: a seat at the table with leadership and a function to build.
* A team of world-class researchers, engineers and operators who ship.
* Competitive salary and equity.
* Benefits: health insurance, meal vouchers, transport

job.description:
**When marketing is more than just campaigns!**

Goede marketing draait niet alleen om clicks. Het gaat om het bouwen van een merk dat mensen herkennen, verhalen vertellen die blijven hangen en aandacht omzetten in meetbare groei.

Goede marketing draait niet alleen om clicks. Het gaat om het bouwen van een merk dat mensen herkennen, verhalen vertellen die blijven hangen en aandacht omzetten in meetbare groei. Weeztix is allang meer dan alleen ticketing. Vandaag de dag helpen we event organisatoren met ticketing, toegangscontrole, cashless oplossingen, CRM en nog veel meer. Onze producten en ambities zijn enorm gegroeid, maar er ligt nog een grote kans om ervoor te zorgen dat de Nederlandse markt ook écht weet wat Weeztix allemaal te bieden heeft.

We zoeken een Marketing Manager Nederland & Weeztix die de volledige verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor onze marketing in Nederland. Iemand die net zo enthousiast wordt van het bouwen aan een sterk merk als van het analyseren van campagne data. Die onze positionering aanscherpt, een campagne bouwt rondom een mooi klant verhaal en daarna precies wil weten wat het heeft opgeleverd.

**Jouw rol in de spotlight**

Als Marketing Manager Nederland ben jij hét marketing aanspreekpunt voor Weeztix in Nederland én de vaste marketingpartner van het Nederlandse managementteam. Jij overziet het hele speelveld: van merk, positionering en content tot digitale campagnes, demand generation, events en marketingprestaties. Je maakt onderdeel uit van het internationale marketingteam van de Weezevent Group. Dat betekent dat je samenwerkt met specialisten uit de hele groep en toegang hebt tot veel kennis en ondersteuning. Tegelijkerrtijd ben jij degene die het dichtst op de Nederlandse markt zit. Jij weet wat er speelt, wat onze klanten belangrijk vinden en hoe Weeztix zich moet laten zien.

Deze rol is voor een bouwer. Er is geen groot Nederlands marketingteam en er ligt geen kant-en-klaar playbook op je te wachten. Je krijgt de vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid om te bepalen wat de Nederlandse markt nodig heeft en dat om te zetten in actie. De ene dag werk je samen met Sales aan een Account-Based Marketing-campagne, de volgende dag ontwikkel je onze positionering voor het komende jaar, analyseer je campagneresultaten of schrijf je een klantcase. En als ADE voor de deur staat? Dan ben jij er natuurlijk ook bij.

**Wat je gaat doen**

* Je ontwikkelt en beheert de marketingstrategie voor Weeztix in Nederland.
* Je vertaalt bedrijfsdoelstellingen naar campagnes, prioriteiten en meetbare resultaten.
* Je bouwt aan een sterk en herkenbaar Weeztix merk in de Nederlandse markt.
* Je ontwikkelt en coördineert digitale marketingcampagnes (paid en organic).
* Je werkt samen met Sales aan leadgeneration, pipeline-opbouw en Account-Based Marketing (ABM).
* Je maakt content zoals klantcases, nieuwsbrieven, social posts, webinars en PR.
* Je analyseert marketingprestaties, ROI en funneldata en zet inzichten om in acties.
* Je organiseert en coördineert Weeztix’ aanwezigheid op events zoals ADE, Festivak en Future of Festivals.

**Jij bent onze top kandidaat wanneer**

Je een brede B2B-marketeer bent die zich net zo thuis voelt in branding als in performance marketing. Je kunt 's ochtends nadenken over de positionering van Weeztix in Nederland en 's middags diep in campagnedata, conversieratio's en pipeline duiken.

Je hebt geen groot team of bureau nodig om dingen voor elkaar te krijgen. Je neemt graag eigenaarschap, bouwt graag iets op en zet ideeën om in actie.
**Dit breng je mee:**

* Ongeveer 5 tot 7 jaar ervaring in B2B-marketing, bij voorkeur binnen SaaS, tech, event-tech of de evenementenbranche.
* Ervaring met zowel brand marketing als digitale/performance marketing.
* Je begrijpt positionering en weet een propositie te vertalen naar een verhaal dat aanslaat in de markt.
* Je hebt ervaring met digitale campagnes, SEO/SEA, paid social, analytics en conversie-optimalisatie.
* Je begrijpt marketingfunnels en weet marketingactiviteiten te koppelen aan leads, pipeline en commerciële resultaten.
* Je hebt ervaring met of een sterke affiniteit voor Account-Based Marketing (ABM).
* Je werkt graag met KPI's, budgetten, dashboards en ROI.
* Je bent een sterke schrijver en communicator en weet complexe onderwerpen helder en aantrekkelijk over te brengen.
* Je bent hands-on en ondernemend: je ontwikkelt de strategie én voert die met plezier zelf uit.
* Je kent de Nederlandse markt en hebt bij voorkeur affiniteit met de event-, festival- of entertainmentindustrie.
* Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

**Welcome to the Weeztix Family**

Weeztix maakt evenementen mogelijk in meer dan 100 landen. Vanuit onze kantoren in Amsterdam, Düsseldorf en Eindhoven werken ruim 70 collega's elke dag aan één missie: de beste event-tech oplossingen ter wereld bouwen.

Als onderdeel van de Weezevent Group combineren we lokaal ondernemerschap met de kennis, technologie en schaal van een internationale organisatie. Voor jou betekent dat iets unieks: volledige verantwoordelijkheid voor de Nederlandse markt, met een internationaal marketingteam achter je. De sfeer? Ambitieus én informeel. Slimme mensen die samen geweldige producten bouwen en ondertussen veel plezier maken.

**Wat je van ons krijgt**

* Een fulltime functie op ons gloednieuwe kantoor in Amsterdam.
* Veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatieven.
* De kans om een grote impact te maken op de groei van Weeztix in Nederland.
* Elke dag een gratis lunch, teamborrels en toegang tot de leukste festivals en evenementen.
* Wekelijks personal training op kantoor en de mogelijkheid tot een elektrische leasefiets.
* 25 vakantiedagen, een goede pensioenregeling (of extra salaris) en de mogelijkheid om 1 keer per jaar volledig remote te werken.

Word jij enthousiast van het bouwen aan een sterk merk én het bewijzen dat marketing werkt? Wil je de vrijheid om eigenaar te zijn van een hele markt, van het verhaal dat we vertellen tot de leads en pipeline die we genereren? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Geen lange assessments. We starten met een korte kennismaking. Is er een match? Dan nodigen we je uit op ons kantoor in Amsterdam om je de wereld van Weeztix te laten zien, en hopelijk ook meer te leren over die van jou.

**ABOUT THE TEAM & ROLE**
=========================

Zalando makes e-commerce easy for our customers and partners. Backed by our tech and logistics expertise dedicated to fashion and lifestyle, we offer innovative business-to-business (B2B) services to our global partners. Our brand, ZEOS, takes this to the next level by opening our best-in-class fulfillment solutions so direct-to-consumer businesses across Europe operate seamlessly.

Our long-tail Partner segment represents a key growth driver in our partner ecosystem. As a Partner Growth Manager, you will scale this partner base by combining proactive account development, strategic enablement, automated sales processes, and AI-driven workflows.

  
  

**WHAT WE'D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)**
=============================================

* **Drive Scalable 1-to-Many Growth:** Lead engagement strategies across our long-tail partner landscape, identifying untapped opportunities to expand partner footprints and drive cross-selling and upselling of additional B2B services.
* **Build Automated Sales & Growth Processes:** Translate commercial insights and hands-on learnings into repeatable, highly automated workflows to scale partner development efficiently without increasing manual overhead.
* **Champion AI-Driven Work Routines:** Leverage cutting-edge generative AI models (such as Gemini and Claude) and explore modern automation solutions to streamline daily work routines, optimize reporting, and eliminate process bottlenecks.
* **Serve as 2nd-Level Escalation & Enablement Hub:** Resolve complex partner requests escalated by 1st-level teams, using root-cause learnings to build Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), documentation, and training materials that permanently empowers the team.
* **Manage Salesforce & Workflows:** Oversee Salesforce pipelines, maintaining accurate case and opportunity tracking while updating documentation to ensure data integrity and operational clarity.
* **Adapt & Innovate Agilely:** Adapt flexibly to dynamic market demands and continuous change, ensuring agility, high partner satisfaction, and scalable growth across the long-tail segment.
  

  

**WE'D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF...**
===============================

* You bring 1–2 years of experience in B2B Account Management, Business Development, Partner Success, or Operations (including high-impact internships or working student roles) managing partner portfolios using 1-to-many approaches.
* You are an AI Native with hands-on experience applying generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) to optimize daily work routines, automate reporting, and innovate process workflows.
* You possess strong commercial acumen, excellent communication skills, and the confidence to lead strategic sales, cross-selling, and upselling conversations.
* You demonstrate strong process-building skills, enjoy deriving SOPs and enablement materials from operational learnings, and have hands-on experience with Salesforce.
* You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments through flexible execution, creative problem-solving, and a balance of self-driven autonomy with cross-functional teamwork.
* You hold a degree in Business, Supply Chain, Economics, or a related field, with fluency in English.
  

  

**OUR OFFER**
=============

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.

* 27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
* 2 paid volunteering days a year
* Employee shares programme
* 40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
* Relocation assistance available (subject to prior agreement)
* Family services, including counselling and support

**Über** **Zalando**
--------------------

Zalando wurde 2008 in Berlin gegründet und ist die führende europäische Technologieplattform für Mode und Lifestyle. Wir verbinden 62 Millionen aktive Kund\*innen mit mehr als 7.000 Marken in 29 Märkten. Unser Geschäft basiert auf einer einzigartigen, KI-gestützten Daten- und Infrastrukturplattform. Für unsere Kund\*innen bietet unser Multi-App-Ansatz – bestehend aus Zalando, ABOUT YOU und Lounge by Zalando – ein inspirierendes, hochgradig personalisiertes Einkaufserlebnis. Für unsere Partner bauen wir das Betriebssystem für den E-Commerce. **Über neoBIM**
---------------

neoBIM entwickelt KI-Software für die Bau- und Immobilienbranche. Unser Konfigurator macht aus einem Grundstück Gebäudevarianten mit Wirtschaftlichkeitsrechnung, unser zweites Produkt liest Gemeinderatsprotokolle und findet Bauvorhaben, bevor sie ausgeschrieben werden. Unsere Kunden sind Systembauer, Generalunternehmer und Bauträger.

PLIERA (pliera.com) ist unsere Produktmarke. Unsere Gründer sind Pioniere der Architektursoftware und wissen, wie man ein Produkt zum Branchenstandard macht.

Bisher entstehen fast alle Gespräche über unseren Outbound-Vertrieb und Messen. Das änderst du: Als erste Marketing-Person baust du Inbound auf, bis Systembauer, Generalunternehmer und Bauträger von sich aus eine Demo anfragen. Du arbeitest täglich eng mit Marko zusammen, unserem Principal Architect. Brand Book, Website, Newsletter und klare Regeln für öffentliche Aussagen gibt es schon.

Für wen ist die Rolle ideal?

* Du willst Marketing selbst aufbauen, nicht verwalten
* Du schreibst, drehst und schneidest lieber selbst, als zu briefen
* Du willst sehen, was dein Content im Vertrieb bewirkt
* Du hast Lust auf eine Branche, in der Marketing noch fast niemand richtig macht

**Deine Aufgaben**
------------------

* Positionierung & Story – mit den Gründern festlegen, wie wir über neoBIM und PLIERA sprechen
* LinkedIn – unser wichtigster Kanal: Unternehmensseiten, Posts für die Gründer, Unterstützung für Markos Feed, dein eigener Feed
* Video – kurze Clips, Videos (gerne mit dir vor der Kamera), App-Walkthroughs für YouTube. Selbst produziert
* Website & Blog – Texte, Formulare für Demo und Test, jede Anfrage mit Quelle im CRM. Inhalte, die bei Google und in ChatGPT oder Perplexity gefunden werden
* Newsletter – übernimmst du
* Content aus Kundengesprächen – zweimal pro Woche bei Vertriebsgesprächen dabei. Daraus werden Posts, Videos, Kundengeschichten und Zitate, jeweils mit Freigabe
* Messen – BAU, EXPO REAL, BIM World: Content vorher, währenddessen und danach. Du bist mit am Stand

**Nach sechs Monaten**

* Gründer und Vertrieb erzählen dieselbe Story, die du entwickelt hast
* Mehr Demo-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die uns selbst gefunden haben
* Jede Woche LinkedIn-Posts vom Team und von dir
* Regelmäßig neue Videos, kurz und ausführlich
* Klarer Weg zur Demo auf der Website, bei jeder Anfrage ist die Quelle bekannt
* Erste Blogartikel ranken, KI-Suche getestet

**Dein Profil**
---------------

* Aufbau von null – mindestens fünf Jahre B2B-Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Content, mindestens einmal die erste Marketing-Person (Startup oder neue Unit)
* Hands-on – Texte, Grafiken und einfacher Videoschnitt kommen von dir. Du zeigst Arbeiten, die zum großen Teil deine sind, und was sie gebracht haben
* Kamera – du hast schon eigene Videos produziert
* SEO & KI-Suche – du hast ein Unternehmen für einen selbst gewählten Suchbegriff sichtbar gemacht und weißt aus eigenen Tests, wie Inhalte in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Googles AI Overviews landen
* KI ja, KI-Sprech nein – du arbeitest täglich mit Claude, ChatGPT o. Ä., unser Content-Workflow ist KI-basiert, aber mit deinem Input und deinem Stil
* Faktentreue – keine ungeprüften Zahlen, keine Kundenlogos ohne Freigabe
* Deutsch & Englisch – in Wort und Schrift so, dass niemand mehr gegenlesen muss

Nice to have

* Du hast selbst schon gegründet
* Systembauer, Generalunternehmer, Bauträger oder Baustoffhersteller als Kunden, PropTech oder ConTech
* Texte für Gründer geschrieben oder Webinare moderiert
* Du hast schon Messen bespielt
* Englisch und Deutsch auch vor der Kamera
* Weitere Fremdsprachen (gerne Koreanisch) sind ein Plus
* Figma, Premiere oder CapCut, Beehiiv, Zoho CRM

Wichtiger als dein Lebenslauf: Eigeninitiative, Persönlichkeit und Lust aufs Machen.

**Arbeitsumfeld und Benefits**
------------------------------

* Marketing von Grund auf aufbauen und prägen, wie neoBIM klingt
* Kurze Wege: Du berichtest an unseren Principal Architect und die Gründer, Entscheidungen fallen in einem Gespräch
* Live-Produkt und echte Kundengespräche als Rohstoff für deinen Content
* Remote in Deutschland oder hybrid in Karlsruhe, dazu Team- und Messetage
* Vollzeit, Start so bald wie möglich
* Gute Hardware und die Tools, die du brauchst
* Echte Einarbeitung und Feedback
